name: Memphis and its Necropolis — the Pyramid Fields from Giza to Dahshur
scaleNote: 0.12 studs per metre. Khufu's base is 230.33 m; at 1 stud/m the Pyramid primitive would lay some 265 000 bricks for one pyramid. At 0.12 the three together are a few thousand and the field still reads as a field.

khufuBase.source: Wikipedia, Great Pyramid of Giza: base side length '230.33 m (756 ft)'.

khufuHeight.source: Wikipedia, Great Pyramid of Giza: original height '146.6 m (481 ft)'; current '138.5 m (454 ft)'.

khafreBase.source: Wikipedia, Pyramid of Khafre: base side length '215.5 m (706 ft)'.

khafreHeight.source: Wikipedia, Pyramid of Khafre: original height '136.4 metres (448 ft)'.

menkaureBase.source: Wikipedia, Pyramid of Menkaure: base side length '108.5 m (356 ft)'.

menkaureHeight.source: Wikipedia, Pyramid of Menkaure: original height '65.5 meters (215 ft)'.

note:
THE SLOPE IS THE PRIMITIVE'S, NOT KHUFU'S, and the difference is small enough to state exactly. `Pyramid` corbels a square footprint inward one stud per brick course, which gives height/base = 0.6. Khufu's real ratio is 146.6/230.33 = 0.637, Khafre's 0.633, Menkaure's 0.604. So this Atlas builds Giza about 6 % too flat for the two large pyramids and almost exactly right for the third. The cited heights are in `dimensions` and unused by the massing, which is why the generator lists them separately: they are the number this model does not hit.

The three are placed on their real relative diagonal — Khufu north-east, Menkaure south-west — but the spacings are read off a plan by eye and are counted as site-plan coordinates.

PALETTE ABGEDUNKELT: Tan (19) und Weiss (15) brennen unter dem Bloom dieses Renderers zu reinweissen Kernen aus -- bei Giza waren zwei der drei Pyramiden im Bild nur noch Licht, waehrend die dritte in Reddish Brown lesbar blieb. Ersetzt durch Light Bluish Gray (71). Die Ursache ist der Bloom, nicht die Belichtung: der Regler der Galerie steht bereits auf seinem Minimum von 0,4.
